authority: Operational dispatch mirror only; live main/accepted evidence and canonical Drive governance override this file.

defaults.mission: Provider-specific integration layer with read/write separation, credentials references, explicit tenant/account binding, rate-limit/health semantics, readback/reconciliation and safe staging.
sources: - TOCA MCP provider references: Google Ads, Instagram/Meta, GCP

tasks.title: W08-00 - Provider Adapter Coordination & Contract Freeze
actions: 1. Revalidate W07 public executor/target contracts and W04 capability bindings.
2. Inventory providers required by downstream W11-W13 and shared services.
3. Freeze provider adapter interface, read/write split, provider binding and ownership paths.
4. Define provider-health/readback/error taxonomy and publication barriers.
5. Create risk/premortem/test plan for credentials, quotas, retries and external ambiguity.
tasks.ownership: W08 provider adapter packages and governance.
tasks.forbidden: Do not implement business campaign/social decisions, Android/device runtime or authority semantics.

tasks.title: W08-A - Provider Binding & External Identity/ID Mapping
actions: 1. Define provider binding references separate from Aurora canonical IDs.
2. Bind tenant/account/provider identities explicitly and fail closed on mismatch.
3. Model provider capabilities/endpoints without leaking provider IDs into canonical entity IDs.
4. Support verification state as precondition metadata only.
5. Add wrong-account/cross-tenant/ambiguous-binding tests.
tasks.forbidden: Provider verification or possession of a valid ID must not become authority.

tasks.title: W08-B - SecretReference & Credential Boundary
actions: 1. Implement credential resolution behind SecretReference/provider credential boundary.
2. Prohibit plaintext secret serialization in PolicyToken, ActionIntent, Evidence, cache, templates, logs or Drive governance.
3. Bind credential lookup to tenant/provider/account context.
4. Support rotation/revocation-aware resolution where architecture permits.
5. Add secret-leak and wrong-tenant credential tests.
tasks.forbidden: Do not store secrets in repository, governance docs or execution evidence.

tasks.title: W08-C - Read Adapter Foundation
actions: 1. Implement provider read adapter interface and normalized response/error mapping.
2. Propagate correlation, tenant/account binding and provider metadata.
3. Support pagination/rate-limit metadata and freshness/provenance.
4. Ensure reads cannot mutate external state.
5. Add deterministic contract tests and safe mocks.
tasks.ownership: Provider read adapters and normalized read models.
tasks.forbidden: Do not perform writes or domain decisions.

tasks.title: W08-D - Governed Write Transport
actions: 1. Implement provider write transports callable only from W07 Executor.
2. Carry idempotency/preconditions/correlation/target binding from executor.
3. Return transport result suitable for readback and uncertainty classification.
4. Prove direct planner/router/model access is impossible through public API.
5. Use paused/no-op/sandbox modes where provider supports them.
tasks.ownership: Provider transport implementation below W07 execution boundary.
tasks.forbidden: Do not expose a public business-command API that bypasses W07.

tasks.title: W08-E - Health, Rate Limits, Quotas & Retry Metadata
actions: 1. Implement provider health/readiness observations and rate-limit/quota parsing.
2. Expose retry-after/backoff metadata without deciding business policy.
3. Distinguish provider outage, auth failure, quota exhaustion, throttling and transient transport failure.
4. Keep health/readiness as preconditions, not authority.
5. Add provider degradation simulations.
tasks.forbidden: Do not let healthy/verified provider bypass Policy/Authority.

tasks.title: W08-F - Readback & Reconciliation Adapters
actions: 1. Implement provider-specific readback required to confirm write outcome.
2. Normalize observed state for W07 reconciliation.
3. Handle eventual consistency, missing resource, duplicate/ambiguous result and delayed provider state.
4. Support reconcile-before-retry for ambiguous writes.
5. Add mismatch/late-readback tests.
tasks.forbidden: Do not silently treat transport success as verified business outcome.

tasks.title: W08-G - Safe Mocks, Staging, Capability Bindings & Integration
actions: 1. Create safe provider mocks/staging harnesses.
2. Bind provider capabilities to W04 target-neutral registry without making provider the capability definition.
3. Run end-to-end adapter tests through W07 using no real unsafe side effects.
4. Run four Risk Gates, credential leak scans and exact-head CI.
5. Publish provider foundation handoff for W11-W13.
tasks.forbidden: Do not implement W11-W13 domain workflows.
